tasks.title: Delete dead recovery-intent machine; promote live coordination fields to race-safe columns
tasks.objective: Remove the unwired recovery-intent service/parser/type/guards entirely, add jobs columns for consecutive_failures, max_consecutive_failures, pause_reason and setup_state via a precondition-guarded cutover migration (backfill from target_json, strip the keys), and convert every writer to targeted single-statement updates: in-DB counter arithmetic, fingerprint-guarded jsonb_set for notify-dedup, plain column sets for pause and clears. Decision 0104.
acceptance_criteria: grep for recoveryIntent|recovery_intent finds nothing in src/ or test/ except the unrelated pending_access_requests column

cutover migration generated via npm run db:migrations:generate: DO-block RAISEs on any non-null recovery intent, backfills the four columns from both blob key spellings, strips those keys from target_json; db:migrations:check green; postgres-migration-journal.test.ts updated with literal-SQL assertions and passing

no writer performs read-modify-write on the promoted fields: counter uses consecutive_failures = consecutive_failures + 1 inside the lease-guarded finalization; notify-dedup uses jsonb_set on notified_fingerprint guarded by WHERE setup_state->>'fingerprint' = expected; pause/clears are plain column sets

concurrent-writers postgres integration test (shape of pattern-candidate-atomic-claim): racing notify-dedup and pause-rewrite lose neither; two parallel failure increments both land; stale-fingerprint notify-dedup is a no-op — the test MUST live in a describe 'job coordination state (Postgres)' with an it titled 'keeps concurrent coordination writes intact'
job status/listing payloads drop the recovery metadata field; visibility and lifecycle suites updated, no shims
rowToJob sources the four fields from columns; toRecordInput/updateJob no longer know them; Job domain shape unchanged for consumers
